Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Wikipedia source and incorrectly stated that Archduke Leopold Salvator’s mother was Archduchess Maria Theresa of Austria. The cited page clearly says his mother was Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies, who is therefore the correct paternal grandmother of Archduchess Dolores.
